characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss, blondid lühikesed juuksed, suured sinised silmad. Seljas kollane T-särk ja sinised püksid. Rõõmsameelne ja uudishimulik nägu. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SÄDE
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk, pruunid patsid, suured rohelised silmad. Seljas roosa kleit ja valged sukapüksid. Sõbralik ja särav nägu. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Lastetuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom corner with light blue walls, a soft green rug on the floor, and a small wooden activity table in the center. A single window on the back wall shows a glimpse of green trees outside. A small, colorful toy box sits in one corner. Warm, soft daylight fills the room. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Päikeseline park
locations.description: Sunny outdoor park area with bright green grass and a small, clear puddle reflecting the blue sky. Gentle spring trees with new green leaves are in the background. A few smooth grey pebbles are near the puddle's edge. Cheerful and bright. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Juku and Säde are sitting on the green rug in the playroom, surrounded by a few colorful toy blocks. Juku is holding a red block, and Säde is holding a blue block. They are looking at each other, smiling. The light blue walls and small wooden activity table are visible. The colorful toy box is in the corner. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are sitting together at the small wooden activity table in the playroom, leaning in close and whispering to each other, both with bright, excited expressions on their faces. The colorful toy box is in the corner, and light blue walls are in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are still sitting at the small wooden activity table in the playroom. Juku points excitedly to a small, smooth stick he found on the table, while Säde holds up a green leaf, both looking determined and happy. The light blue walls are in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku is looking inside the colorful toy box in the playroom, rummaging through it with a curious expression. Säde stands nearby, holding a small stick she already found, patiently waiting. The light blue walls and green rug are visible. Cartoon style.

Säde is carefully picking up several colorful leaves from the green rug in the playroom, placing them neatly on the small wooden activity table. Juku is sitting at the table, organizing a few small sticks. They are focused on their task. Light blue walls are visible in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are sitting side-by-side at the small wooden activity table in the playroom, proudly holding up a small, simple boat they assembled from sticks and leaves. They are both smiling broadly at their creation. The light blue walls are in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are standing near the window in the playroom, holding their small stick-and-leaf boat. Juku points towards the green trees visible through the window, and Säde looks at him with an eager expression. They are ready to go outside. The light blue walls and green rug are visible. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are standing at the edge of a small, clear puddle in a sunny outdoor park area with bright green grass. Juku holds the boat carefully, and Säde is looking at the water with wide, curious eyes. Gentle spring trees with new green leaves are in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are both kneeling happily at the edge of the small, clear puddle in the sunny outdoor park. Their small stick-and-leaf boat is floating gently on the water. Juku is gently pushing the boat, and Säde is watching it with a joyful smile. Bright green grass and spring trees are in the background. Cartoon style.

Juku and Säde are standing by the small puddle, watching their boat float. They are both laughing joyfully, holding hands. The sun shines brightly on the green grass and spring trees in the sunny outdoor park. Cartoon style.
